# Vendored upstream archive engine

`7zip-d3296e39.tar.gz` is an unmodified GitHub source archive of
[7-Zip](https://github.com/ip7z/7zip) at commit
`d3296e39e1f1f92c7b41c0c3848e65640428d42d`.
SHA-256: `adef737a73a2668d26c0733e496e1600662af2a8779e084e6475a0162e012576`.

The release build compiles the standalone Alone2 console executable and names
it `zfm-archive-engine` (or `zfm-archive-engine.exe`). The underlying program
is 7-Zip by Igor Pavlov; renaming the executable does not change its license.
The unmodified source and notices accompany the executable in packages. See
`LICENSES/7zip` and `LEGAL/THIRD_PARTY.md`.
